title: Move the Emulation folder
offerTitle: Move the Emulation folder out of PlayOut's folder?
offerLead: Your Emulation folder is inside PlayOut's install folder. Uninstalling PlayOut would delete it with your saves and ROMs. PlayOut can move it to your Documents folder.
nothingToMove: The Emulation folder in use is empty: nothing to move. PlayOut will use the new place.
size_one: Moves {size} ({count} file): your saves, BIOS files, ROMs and everything else in it.
size_other: Moves {size} ({count} files): your saves, BIOS files, ROMs and everything else in it.
sameDrive: Same drive: the folder is renamed, which is instant.
otherDrive: Other drive: everything is copied and checked, then the old folder is deleted.
targetIsEmulation: The new place is already an Emulation folder. Move into it: files missing there are added, and where both have a file the newer one is kept. Or use it as it is: nothing is moved and the old folder stays where it is.
targetNotEmpty: The new place already holds files. Move into it: files missing there are added, and where both have a file the newer one is kept. Or use it as it is: nothing is moved.
doneSwitched: PlayOut now uses {path}. Nothing was moved.
doneEmulators: The emulators are being pointed at the new folder, and the ROMs are scanned again.
leftInOld_one: {count} file stayed in {path}: the new folder had a newer copy, or it was in use.
leftInOld_other: {count} files stayed in {path}: the new folder had newer copies, or they were in use.
keptOlder_one: {count} older file in the new folder was replaced; its old copy is kept beside it (.playout-old).
keptOlder_other: {count} older files in the new folder were replaced; their old copies are kept beside them (.playout-old).
unchanged: Nothing changed: the Emulation folder is still {path}.
